dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, feathered light-colored perimeters with an abrupt gradient transition from the dark exterior to the light ring, and a similar transition to the dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of irregular, solid high-intensity pixel clusters localized along the upper dorsal ridge, lacking internal gradients or central dark cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent circular rings in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, while a sequence of smaller rings towards the posterior forms a sub-linear geometric chain.
